resources.name: UCSD Network Telescope
quotes: Network Telescopes: These network infrastructures monitor traffic reaching Internet address space that is not assigned to hosts but is advertised to the global routing system [32].
references: [32] David Moore, Colleen Shannon, Geoffrey M Voelker, and Stefan Savage. 2004. Network Telescopes: Technical Report. Technical Report. Cooperative Association for Internet Data Analysis (CAIDA).
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The resource is mentioned in the 'Related Work' section to contrast the passive nature of network telescopes with the active capabilities of honeypots.
